- Expensify #102630 draft (follows the official Expensify proposal template): problem is `?state=MO` losing to the saved state on hard reload at /settings/profile/address; root cause is two racing effects — StateSelector (child) applies the state from the URL then immediately deletes the param, and the AddressPage (parent) sync effect then overwrites the form with the saved address from late Onyx hydration. Fix is a narrow ref in AddressPage set only when the URL handler applies a parameter, so the sync effect skips state/country only in that case (other fields still sync normally) — narrower than competing proposals' broad 'any user edit' flag. Test: new cases in tests/ui/AddressPageTest.tsx (saved CA + ?state=MO shows Missouri, symmetric country case, plus no-param regression). (src: memory/2026-11-18.md:211)

- Expensify #102630 draft (follows the official Expensify proposal template): problem is `?state=MO` losing to the saved state on hard reload at /settings/profile/address; root cause is two racing effects — StateSelector (child) applies the state from the URL then immediately deletes the param, and the AddressPage (parent) sync effect then overwrites the form with the saved address from late Onyx hydration. Fix is a narrow ref in AddressPage set only when the URL handler applies a parameter, so the sync effect skips state/country only in that case (other fields still sync normally) — narrower than competing proposals' broad 'any user edit' flag. Test: new cases in tests/ui/AddressPageTest.tsx (saved CA + ?state=MO shows Missouri, symmetric country case, plus no-param regression). (src: memory/2026-11-18.md:218)
